name: Autonomous Ecosystem — From Room to Self-Sustaining Greenhouse
description: Development and implementation of a three-phase autonomous ecosystem under AI control. Phase 1: indoor ecosystem with plant zoning. Phase 2: fully autonomous year-round greenhouse. Phase 3: integration of renewable energy sources (solar, wind, water) for complete energy independence.

phase_1.name: Indoor Ecosystem
phase_1.description: Create a working prototype for microclimate control in a single room with plant zoning.

hardware.controller: ESP32 — optimal for prototype (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, low power consumption)
sensors: Soil moisture: capacitive sensors (I2C) — durable and accurate
Air temperature and humidity: DHT22 or SHT31
actuators: Controllable sockets/relays for watering, misting, lighting, ventilation

software.platform: Home Assistant — open system with web interface and mobile app
software.automation: Rules (trigger → condition → action) and AI integration via AI Tasks

deliverables: Working prototype with sensors and controllable sockets
AI integration (data reading, control via AI Tasks)

phase_2.name: Outdoor Autonomous Greenhouse
phase_2.description: Build a fully autonomous year-round greenhouse with AI control, scaling Phase 1 architecture. Starts after Phase 1 completion.
key_improvements: Scaling: replace ESP32 with STM32F103RCT6 or multiple ESP32s per zone
Increase sensor count (20+), add CO₂ and soil pH sensors
Use ZigBee for low-power mesh sensor network
Implement AI algorithms: PID controllers with PSO optimization or reinforcement learning
deliverables: Fully automated greenhouse with AI-controlled climate, watering, lighting
Integration with Home Assistant and AI

phase_3.name: Energy Autonomy
phase_3.description: Integrate renewable energy sources to create a fully self-sufficient ecosystem. Starts after Phase 2 completion.
components: Small wind turbine (1-3 kW) for nighttime/winter compensation
Battery system (LiFePO4) with Energy Management System (EMS)
phase_3.integration: EMS integrates with Home Assistant and AI, which makes decisions based on energy balance (activate/deactivate loads to extend autonomy)

source: Dialogue between Gardener (Voodoo) and External SR (DeepSeek), 2026-07-13
